title: Capitode Review 2026: Risk Check
description: Thinking of signing up with Capitode? Its page lists bonds trading, debit card deposits and a $250 minimum, but names no regulator or licence.
author: Daniel Carter
excerpt: Capitode is presented as a "trading bot" with "substantial growth possibilities" and "established trading providers", but no provider or regulator is named.
content:
Capitode is presented as a "trading bot" with "substantial growth possibilities" and "established trading providers", but no provider or regulator is named. The page offers no verifiable performance data. Outside verification was not run.

What the page says

  • Platform type: web-based trading platform
  • Technology: AI technology
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: bonds
  • Payment methods: debit cards
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal up to 24h
  • Registration fee: no registration fee
  • Support: continuous support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
